newsitem.title: USA: Long John Silver's hires Jordan, McGrath for ads.
newsitem.headline: Long John Silver's hires Jordan, McGrath for ads.

text.p: Long John Silver's said it assigned broadcast creative responsibilities to New York-based Jordan, McGrath, Case & Taylor and named Western International Media of Los Angeles its media services agency.
The company said its creative and media account, worth about $60 million, had been consolidated with Temerlin McClain advertising in Dallas since 1989.

"We felt it would be in the best interest of Long John Silver's to find an agency to bring fresh resources to the effort of repositioning the concept," Michael Kern, senior vice president of marketing at the company, said.
